description: This file contains unit tests for the 'buildContextReply' function in the context-report module, using the Vitest testing framework. It defines various test cases to verify the behavior of the context reply generation based on different input parameters, particularly focusing on bootstrap truncation warnings, fallback configurations, and context estimation details.
